sources.claim: The spike must answer how load/iterations are applied and how to skip the rest of an iteration on failure.
The spike must file a follow-up implementation Story against Epic MOB-47570.
Design Alternative A (skip logic in generated code) is SELECTED over apiritif-flag and executor-wrapper alternatives.
Assumption A4 (apiritif does not auto-abort remaining iterations) is VALIDATE, gated on a falsification test.
The plan documents the recommended implementation approach and design for a follow-up Story.
The plan's Failure Modes section documents the residual apiritif.loadgen iteration-abort risk and validation step.
The Requirement Traceability Matrix maps AC-1 and AC-2 to FR/tasks/verification gates.
Semantic disambiguation found no forbidden identifiers; skip_on_failure is NEW, SKIPPED and iteration are USE.
